text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Early morning shoots seriously need to disappear...
I'm so sleep-deprived, seriously...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A nap... until training...
I'll wake up in time... probably...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
......So noisy...
Just let me sleep already...
And so, Gold City ended up skipping training that day.
